query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS project_count, SUM(CASE WHEN enterpriseName='海豚知道' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS haitun_project_count, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(id, ':', enterpriseName) ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ' | ') AS project_names FROM projects;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(id, ':', COALESCE(name,''), '/', COALESCE(email,''), '/', COALESCE(loginMethod,'')) ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ' | ') AS user_summary FROM users;
